title: A commit message that cites a ruling names its home and time
why: A test-author's commit (5568b42ac on #2024) called a lane pick an "owner ruling", and a later agent refused work on the strength of it (lane notes-fix-page, [ended:lane:-notes-fix-page], 08:16 CST Nov 8). An unsourced ruling claim reads as the owner's word.
note: Same class as triage's P44 (a record sentence counts as the owner's ruling only if git shows his words). Done check: a red test where a commit message that says "owner ruling" or "owner's ruling" with no home (record, page item or step) and no time is refused at commit or push. A check's verdict changes, so this is a build lane. Filed by triage 08:15 CST Nov 8. Coordinator starts its lane, 08:17 CST Nov 8. Doing 05:58 CST Nov 10: open PR #2053 on branch ruling-cite-in-commit (triage live build). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane.
